checks.name: Patient overlap
checks.description: Measure unique-patient overlap across prepared splits without exposing patient identifiers.

checks.name: Population description
checks.description: Describe aggregate population distributions and preserve original missing-demographic indicators.

checks.name: Numeric input contract
checks.description: Diagnose ordered feature schema, finite numeric values, missingness and row alignment; not clinical semantics.

checks.name: Cohort and outcome description
checks.description: Describe encounter and patient counts, class balance and available source-selection evidence.

checks.name: Prediction-time availability
checks.description: Diagnose whether prediction time and feature availability are supported; missing evidence is unverifiable.

checks.name: Outcome observability
checks.description: Diagnose target encoding, source-label alignment and the limits of follow-up observation.

checks.name: Preprocessing provenance
checks.description: Diagnose prepared-input provenance and unsupported preprocessing or leakage-free claims.
